```{r}
# Load Libraries and Define File Paths
library(auk)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)

# File paths
f_ebd <- "~/Spatial raptors project /ebd_US-OH_200501_202412_smp_relJan-2026/ebd_US-OH_200501_202412_smp_relJan-2026.txt"

f_smp <- "~/Spatial raptors project /ebd_US-OH_200501_202412_smp_relJan-2026/ebd_US-OH_200501_202412_smp_relJan-2026_sampling.txt"
```

```{r}
#Define Target Species
raptor_species <- c(
  # Accipitriformes
  "Red-tailed Hawk", "Red-shouldered Hawk", "Broad-winged Hawk",
  "Cooper's Hawk", "Sharp-shinned Hawk", "Northern Harrier",
  "Rough-legged Hawk", "Bald Eagle", "Golden Eagle",
  "Osprey",
  # Falconiformes
  "American Kestrel", "Merlin", "Peregrine Falcon",
  # Cathartidae
  "Turkey Vulture", "Black Vulture",
  # Strigiformes
  "Great Horned Owl", "Barred Owl", "Eastern Screech-Owl",
  "American Barn Owl", "Short-eared Owl", "Long-eared Owl",
  "Snowy Owl", "Northern Saw-whet Owl"
)

length(raptor_species)
```

```{r auk_filter}
# Defining the filters
ebd_filters <- auk_ebd(f_ebd, file_sampling = f_smp) %>%
  auk_state("US-OH") %>%
  auk_date(date = c("2005-01-01", "2024-12-31")) %>%
  auk_species(raptor_species) %>%
  auk_protocol(protocol = c("Stationary", "Traveling")) %>%
  auk_duration(duration = c(5, 240)) %>%
  auk_distance(distance = c(0, 8)) %>%
  auk_complete()

# Output paths
f_ebd_out <- "data/ebd_OH_raptors_filtered.txt"
f_smp_out <- "data/ebd_OH_raptors_sampling_filtered.txt"
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Execute filter (long-running step)
auk_filter(ebd_filters,
           file = f_ebd_out,
           file_sampling = f_smp_out,
           overwrite = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# Read filtered text files 
ebd <- read_ebd(f_ebd_out)
sampling <- read_sampling(f_smp_out)

# Applying observer count filter (1-10 observers) and assigning seasonal flags
sampling <- sampling %>%
  filter(number_observers >= 1 & number_observers <= 10) %>%
  mutate(
    month_val = month(observation_date),
    yday_val  = yday(observation_date),
    is_breeding = (yday_val >= 121 & yday_val <= 212),  # May 1 – Jul 31
    is_winter   = (month_val %in% c(12, 1, 2))           # Dec, Jan, Feb
  ) %>%
  filter(is_breeding | is_winter)

# Keep only EBD records matching retained sampling checklists
ebd <- ebd %>%
  filter(sampling_event_identifier %in% sampling$sampling_event_identifier) #Keep only rows in ebd where the checklist ID exists in sampling

head(ebd)
head(sampling)
```

```{r}
#Breeding subset
samp_breeding <- sampling %>% filter(is_breeding)
ebd_breeding  <- ebd %>%
  filter(sampling_event_identifier %in% samp_breeding$sampling_event_identifier) 
#Keep only bird observations that belong to breeding-season checklists.

```

```{r}
# ZERO-FILL: Convert detection-only to detection/non-detection
zf_raw <- auk_zerofill(ebd_breeding, samp_breeding, collapse = TRUE)

# Force into a plain usable data frame
if (inherits(zf_raw, "auk_zerofill")) {
  zf_breeding <- as.data.frame(zf_raw$observations) %>%
    left_join(as.data.frame(zf_raw$sampling_events), by = "sampling_event_identifier")
} else if (is.data.frame(zf_raw)) {
  zf_breeding <- as.data.frame(zf_raw)
} else {
  obs_df  <- as.data.frame(zf_raw[["observations"]])
  samp_df <- as.data.frame(zf_raw[["sampling_events"]])
  zf_breeding <- left_join(obs_df, samp_df, by = "sampling_event_identifier")
  rm(obs_df, samp_df)
}

# Patch common_name from eBird taxonomy if missing
if (!"common_name" %in% names(zf_breeding) && "scientific_name" %in% names(zf_breeding)) {
  zf_breeding <- zf_breeding %>%
    left_join(
      auk::ebird_taxonomy %>% select(scientific_name, common_name) %>% distinct(),
      by = "scientific_name"
    )
}

# DERIVE ANALYTICAL VARIABLES
zf_breeding <- zf_breeding %>%
  mutate(
    species_observed = as.integer(species_observed),
    year        = year(observation_date),
    day_of_year = yday(observation_date),
    time_hours   = as.numeric(hms(time_observations_started)) / 3600,
    effort_hours = duration_minutes / 60,
    log_effort   = log(effort_hours)
  )

# Distance covariate (traveling protocol)
if ("effort_distance_km" %in% names(zf_breeding)) {
  zf_breeding <- zf_breeding %>% mutate(log_distance = log(effort_distance_km + 0.001))
}

# Observer skill proxy
if ("number_species" %in% names(zf_breeding)) {
  zf_breeding <- zf_breeding %>% mutate(n_species = number_species) #number species is Used as a proxy for observer skill
} else {
  zf_breeding <- zf_breeding %>% mutate(n_species = NA_real_)
}

# SAVE
saveRDS(zf_breeding, "data/ebird_breeding_raptors.rds")

```
